import sys

import impl, flags, intervals, schedule, engine

# csvfix: quotes, trimming, column validation, blank/bad handling
print("csv quoted:", impl.parse('"a,b" , 2 , x'))
print("csv bad cols:", impl.parse("a,2"), impl.parse("a,b,c,d"))
print("csv escaped quote:", impl.parse('"he said ""hi""" , 1 , 2'))
print("csv total:", impl.total([["a","1","2"],["b","2",""]]))
try:
    impl.total([["a","1","oops"]])
except ValueError as e:
    print("csv bad amount ->", type(e).__name__)

# flags: terminator, bundle, repeated, value that looks like switch
print("flags:", flags.Impl().parse(["--k=v","-ab","x","--","--y","z"]))
print("flags switch then value:", flags.Impl().parse(["--mode","--other","fast"]))
print("flags single-dash value:", flags.Impl().parse(["--k","-5"]))

# intervals: overlap/nested/adjacent/gap and subtract edge
I = intervals.Impl()
print("merge nested:", I.merge([[0,10],[2,3]]))
print("merge gap1:", I.merge([[1,2],[4,5]], 1))
print("subtract touch right:", I.subtract([[0,4]], (4,9)))
print("subtract normalize:", I.subtract([[5,7],[1,3]], (2,6)))
print("total_length overlap:", I.total_length([[0,2],[2,4]]))

# schedule
print("slots gap==minutes splits:", schedule.slots([(0,60),(30,90),(120,150)], 30))
print("overlaps touching:", schedule.overlaps((0,10),(10,20)))

# rules
print("rules all/any:", engine.evaluate({"all":["a","b"]},{"a":True,"b":False}),

      engine.evaluate({"all":[]},{}), engine.evaluate({"any":[]},{}),
      engine.evaluate({"all":["missing"]},{}))
PY"}
